title: Preserve missing non-entity join results
goal: Preserve unmatched join rows using nullable scalar markers when shipped EF projections cannot materialize missing objects.

selectionNotes: Actual EF11.0.0 SQLite Windows x64: DTO, anonymous, grouped DTO and default-struct unmatched rows fail materialization after successful translation; nullable-struct composition fails translation. Both pinned consumers verify nullable-marker scalar projection, explicit client DTO/null, nullable/default struct construction, populated (1,12), SQL filtering and client grouping. Direct whole-object missing semantics are withdrawn for this graph. Other providers/platforms are not-tested.
